root_cause.explanation: IC-SPLC categorical values are anonymized frequency-ranked codes. The publisher does not provide a mapping to real countries or industries. preprocess_ic_splc.py preserves them, build_graph_dataset.py combines them with AnonNet/SAMPOQ nodes, and the dashboard previously aggregated them without source context.

country.label: Country
notes: IC-SPLC country values are anonymized frequency-ranked codes; their mapping to real countries is not published.
AnonNet location values are preserved as source-provided country names.
SAMPOQ has no country field in the acquired source.

industry.label: Industry
notes: IC-SPLC industry values are anonymized frequency-ranked codes; their mapping to real industries is not published.
AnonNet and SAMPOQ have no industry field in the acquired sources.
No verified industry names exist in the current graph.
